core.title: Wiltshire Single Cylinder Entrance Set, Weslock 7680

text.description_html:
Weslock 7680, Wiltshire Single Cylinder Handleset

Easy to install, the Wiltshire Entryset will fit door thicknesses from 1-3/4 inches to 2 inches. There is an optional thick door kit that will accommodate doors with thicknesses from 2 inches to 2-1/4 inches. It will adjust to fit doors with backsets of 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches. A single cylinder handleset, the deadbolt is operated by a key from the exterior and a thumbturn from the interior; while the latchbolt underneath the deadbolt is operated by a turn knob from the interior and a thumbpiece from the exterior. An ANSI rated grade 2 lock, this 19-1/4 inch outside trim handleset made by Weslock not only looks fantastic, it is made with the attention to quality Weslock is known for. The Wiltshire Arched Handleset will be sure to make an impression. The beveled edges paired with the curved handle are a picture of elegance and subtle beauty. The Wiltshire handleset will add a touch of simple richness to your doors.

Single Cylinder Handleset: From the exterior, a thumb piece operates the latch and a key operates the deadbolt. From the interior, the lever operates the latch and a thumbturn operates the deadbolt.

Also available matching:
Wiltshire Dummy Handleset

This traditionally styled handleset is from the Weslock Molten Bronze Collection which features easy installation as well as lifetime mechanical and finish warranties. Meets ANSI grade 2 lock standards.

Features of the Weslock Molten Bronze Wiltshire Single Cylinder Handleset:

  • Material: solid molten bronze.
  • Meets ANSI A 156.2 grade 2 lock standards.
  • 5-pin cylinder.
  • 1 inch throw deadbolt with two hardened steel rollers to prevent sawing.
  • Fits standard doors preparations with either 1-5/8" or 2-1/8" top and 2-1/8" bottom cross holes and 1" edge hole and a 5-1/2" center to center cross hole spacing.
  • Manufacturer Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty
  • Manufacturer Limited 10 Year Finish Warranty

Specifications of the Wiltshire Weslock Single Cylinder Entryset:

  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Exterior Length: 19-1/4"
  • Exterior Width: 2-3/4"
  • Exterior Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Interior Length: 10-1/8"
  • Interior Width: 2-3/4"
  • Interior Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/4" to 2" with optional thick door kit for doors 2" to 2-1/4"
  • Backset: adjustable for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" with removable faceplates.

The inside trim will match the handleset's finish.
